rigs.title: Lumberjack on a road
rigs.instruction: A lumberjack's hut stands roaded to your castle beside a wood. Watch one full cycle: the serf leaving, his pace tile-to-tile, the door transition, and a tree felled.
rigs.result: He WALKS (no teleport), at a deliberate ~247 ticks/tile, slides through the door, and fells a tree in five visible stages leaving a stump.

rigs.title: Split a live road
rigs.instruction: A road runs from your castle flag to a lone flag. Plant a new flag on a tile in the MIDDLE of that road to split it in two.
rigs.result: BOTH halves staff themselves — a distinct carrier appears on each half (the round-8 bug left the new half unstaffed).

rigs.title: Resources leave the castle by hand
rigs.instruction: A lumberjack's hut sits at the end of a two-flag road from your castle. Watch a resource leave the castle and travel to the hut.
rigs.result: A serf carries it OUT THE CASTLE DOOR and it is handed flag-to-flag along the road — never materializing on a flag, never teleporting.

rigs.title: Leave the map running
rigs.instruction: A forester works a wood beside open water. Leave the settlement running and watch the map itself: saplings, a felled trunk, planting, and the water.
rigs.result: Saplings grow into trees on the map clock, trunks rot to stumps and vanish, the forester's plantings mature over map-time, and fish are present in the water.

rigs.title: The whole loop, pre-founded
rigs.instruction: A castle, a self-staffing road, and a lumberjack by a wood are already standing. Watch the loop: serfs moving, a resource delivered, trees worked.
rigs.result: Serfs walk at pace through real doors on self-staffing roads; every gathered resource is hand-carried castle-to-site; trees fall in stages and regrow.

rigs.title: Fisher at the shore
rigs.instruction: A fisher's hut stands by stocked water, roaded to your castle. Watch where the fisher works.
rigs.result: He works at the shore in the open, in a visible standing pose.

rigs.title: Farm on open ground
rigs.instruction: A farm stands roaded to your castle on open ground. Watch the farmer.
rigs.result: He sows and harvests at visible field positions around the farm.

rigs.title: Forester planting
rigs.instruction: A forester's hut stands roaded to your castle by a wood. Watch him plant.
rigs.result: He plants saplings outdoors, away from the hut.

rigs.title: Geologist on the hills
rigs.instruction: Ore-bearing hills sit beside your castle. Send a geologist up (flag near the hills) and watch.
rigs.result: A geologist prospects on the hills and plants prospecting signs.

rigs.title: Burn a building down
rigs.instruction: A lumberjack's hut stands roaded to your castle. Demolish it and watch.
rigs.result: A fire countdown plays and the serfs inside escape.

rigs.title: A contested border
rigs.instruction: You and an enemy hold neighbouring ground, each with a border military post. Order an attack on an enemy building and read the outcome; order more; toggle garrison settings.
rigs.result: You pick an enemy building + knight count; knights march from border posts keeping each garrison's minimum; they clash decisively on open ground; you can win AND lose; send-strongest/weakest and cycling respond.

rigs.title: Editor, half-authored
rigs.instruction: The map editor opens on a half-built draft. Look at the canvas, paint terrain/heights, place objects/minerals/starts, run validate, then play it.
rigs.result: Authentic tiles (not placeholders); brushes write; validate gives a real verdict; a local game launches on your map with no network.

rigs.title: A map staged to publish
rigs.instruction: A finished map is staged for the community gallery. Publish it, browse the gallery, rate it, then download and play it.
rigs.result: It publishes within the size/quota limits; the gallery shows sprite-free thumbnails; you rate once per device key; it plays locally and in multiplayer.
